title: Solidarity First Insurance — Medical Network (الشبكة الطبية)
notes: Data from the JSON behind the public network search form (ExecuteSequanceTransaction, sequence 859), driven through a headless browser session. The endpoint caps results at 1000 rows, so Doctors and Pharmacies were re-queried per city (42 cities) and Doctors in Amman per area (89 areas); all results unioned by provider ID. Provider categories 8 'Non Network' and 11 'TPA' were excluded. Person vs facility is decided by the source's HOID code (JOR-P-* = practitioner, JOR-F-* = facility); dentists are mostly JOR-P and therefore practitioner records. name_en = NAME1 with its segment-code prefix removed. Every record is STATUS 'Active' with a contract start/end date (mostly 2019-07-01 → 2050-12-31); no network-wide effective date is published. Practitioner mobiles and personal emails omitted; the insurer's own customerservice@solidarity.com.jo placeholder email dropped. Coordinates outside Jordan's bounding box (e.g. -100,-100 placeholders) dropped. Category 12 'Emergency centres' and 6 'Specialised eye centres' mapped to clinic, 13 'Medical suppliers' to other. Counts: {"practitioner": 2792, "pharmacy": 1103, "other": 58, "rehabilitation": 135, "hospital": 57, "laboratory": 246, "optician": 52, "imaging_center": 68, "clinic": 64, "dental_clinic": 30}
